data.exact_reserve_text: The overall result in 2024 benefitted from the higher yield investment environment and a prior year reserve release of GBP 19.7m (2023: GBP 13.4).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserves held in respect of the event; the report states reserves (including outwards reinstatement premiums) booked in response to this event continue to be held at $35.7m and an estimate for net losses arising is held within IBNR.

named_events.loss_description: We believe that the January California Wildfire is unlikely to have any material impact on the estimates made in drawing up these financial statements.

There has been no change to the net reserves, including outwards reinstatement premiums, booked in response to this event which continue to be held at $35.7m. Our estimate for net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war is currently held at GBP 4.7m of IBNR (2023: GBP 18.0m).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2024 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 907.953m. During the year there was an adverse movement in prior year estimates: the note 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' shows a gross strengthening of GBP 97.477m (10.7% of opening gross claims). This gross adverse development contrasts with a narrative reference to a net prior year release of GBP 19.7m (net of reinsurance). The movement is reflected across the claims provision reconciliation and the gross claims development table; reinsurers' share movements partially offset the gross deterioration. No single large natural catastrophe is identified as the primary driver in the notes, though geopolitical exposures (Russia/Ukraine) and reinsurance recoveries are called out in the report.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year strengthening (GBP 97.477m) is taken from the movement line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' in Technical Provisions (note 18). The Managing Agent narrative quotes a net prior year release of GBP 19.7m (net of reinsurance), producing an apparent discrepancy between gross and net perspectives. The gross figure (insurance liabilities column) is used per instructions. No RITC adjustment was identified. Some event-level amounts were provided in USD in the narrative ($35.7m) and have been left as null where GBP equivalents are not explicitly stated.
